rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive fuzzing capabilities through the AFL++ framework. Offers tools for workspace management, instrumented binary compilation with various sanitizers and coverage modes, corpus management and minimization, fuzzing campaign orchestration across multiple instances, and crash analysis with triage reporting. Supports multiple build systems including Make, CMake, and Cargo, with strict path validation for security. Designed for security researchers integrating systematic fuzz testing into vulnerability discovery workflows.
